description.summary: The caster emulates the MP draining ability of an Emerald Eye
description.value: The caster emulates the MP draining ability of an Emerald Eye. The target takes 5d6 points of MP damage (Fortitude save to negate). Damage dealt this way heals the caster’s MP pool. If used against enemy summoned creatures it is less effective, the target takes full MP damage whereas the caster only drains half on a failed save. This spell does not work when used on an allied summoned creature, either through a Summon spell, Limit Break, or other summon ability. Learned From Emerald Eye, Gheist, Hecteyes Family, Silver Dragon Family, and Tiamat
